LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_INTRO_DESCRI.translation: Synchronization connects Go.Data installations. One instance sends its data (for example, a municipality) and another one receives and gathers it (for example, the national server). This way, the receiver has a consolidated view and nobody needs to enter anything twice.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_CALLOUT_TITL.translation: Going to receive data? Start by generating the keys

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_CALLOUT_DESC.translation: Before anything is sent, the instance that receives the data must add an origin in "Data receiving". It generates the client ID and secret, the keys the other instance uses to connect. Without these keys, no instance can send data here.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_1_DESCR.translation: In "Data receiving", add an origin for each instance that will send data, with the type "Go.Data instance". Use the generate button to create the client ID and secret and the copy button to send them to the person responsible for the other instance. Keep the origin active.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_2_DESCR.translation: In "Data sending", add the instance that will receive the data: enter its URL and paste the client ID and secret generated in step 1. Use the "Check server" and "Test credentials" buttons to confirm everything is right before saving.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_3_TITLE.translation: Choose when and what to synchronize

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_3_DESCR.translation: In the same form, choose "When to send": every 1, 6, 12 or 24 hours, or only manually. "Synchronize now", on the page of the destination, sends at any time. In "Outbreaks offered to the destination" you choose which outbreaks are offered; the destination decides which ones it accepts.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_STEP_4_DESCR.translation: The "History" tab of each origin and of each destination shows its synchronizations. "Track synchronization" holds the full history, with the direction, the status and, when something goes wrong, the error details.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_DIRECTIO.translation: Does the synchronization go both ways?
No. The data only goes from the sending instance to the receiving one. If both need to send data to each other, each one must add the other as a destination.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_WHAT_IS_.translation: What is sent in each synchronization?

The first synchronization sends all the data. The next ones send only what was created or updated since the last successful synchronization. When there is nothing new, the synchronization ends as "Up to date".

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_OUTBREAK.translation: Can I send only some outbreaks?

Yes. Choose them in "Outbreaks offered to the destination", when editing the destination, or in the advanced options of "Synchronize now". When a new outbreak is added, the next synchronization sends all its data.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_OVERWRIT.translation: Can the synchronization delete or overwrite the receiver's data?
A record is only updated when the received version is newer than the existing one. The receiver's own settings, such as roles, system settings and customized translations, are not changed.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_RECEIVER.translation: Can the receiving instance change the data of the sending instance?

No. If the receiving instance edits a received record, the change stays only there and never goes back to the sender. The sender remains the owner of the record: when it changes that record again, its version replaces the edit made here in the answers that come from it (answers of questions that exist only here are kept). So, to fix received data, ask the sender to fix it at the source, and it will arrive here in the next synchronization. Information that belongs to this instance should be kept in questions that exist only in the questionnaire here.

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_FAILED_Q.translation: The synchronization failed. What should I do?

LNG_PAGE_SYNC_DOCUMENTATION_FAQ_FAILED_A.translation: The progress window shows the step that failed and why. The most common causes are the destination being offline, a wrong URL or invalid or disabled credentials. The full details are in the "History" tab of the destination and in "Track synchronization". If the problem continues, contact the administrator of the destination.
